firstLocalAppearance.subject: refactor: split the eight files held back from formatting and format them
firstLocalAppearance.message:
refactor: split the eight files held back from formatting and format them

These files would exceed the 400-line limit once formatted, so the
format PR left them out. Each gives up a cohesive, move-only chunk; the
"to split" block in .oxfmtrc.json is now empty.

- creation/creationService.ts -> creationJobs.ts (job record, duplicate
  check, provider references, failure classification).
- session/automationService.ts -> automationValidation.ts (error types,
  schedule rule validation; InvalidCronExprError still re-exported).
- ui WorkflowEditor.tsx -> workflowShortcuts.ts, WorkflowHistoryPane.tsx.
- ui StudioCreationPage.tsx -> creationInput.ts, CreationFiles.tsx; the
  three reference/frame states become one files record.
- dynamic-workflow: placeholder-resolution.ts (from analysis/state.ts),
  operators.ts (from analysis/taint.ts), scheduler-helpers.ts and
  workflow-error.ts (re-exported from scheduler.ts / types.ts, so import
  paths are unchanged).

dynamic-workflow has no tests, so the analyzer was checked by running
scratch/run.mjs on three sample scripts (loops, &&/??/comma, compound
assignment, element access, rest-parameter relays) against builds from
before and after: the site and actor graphs are identical.
